name: Aserai
description: The Aserai inhabit the southern desert lands of Calradia and combine footmen and horsemen in battle.

name: Battania
description: The Battanians are famed for their marksmanship as archers throughout Calradia.

name: Khuzait Khanate
description: The Khuzaits are a steppe tribe confederacy and makes heavy use of horse archers.

name: Sturgia
description: The Sturgians inhabit the northern woodlands and are lethal axe-men and swordsmen.

name: Vlandia
description: The Vlandians are a feudal state that specializes in heavy cavalry.

name: Northern Empire
description: Led by the aristocratic senator Emperor Lucon, who claims the Senate should pick the emperor.

name: Southern Empire
description: Led by Empress Rhagaea, who claims that Ira should rule as Arenicos' only child.

name: Western Empire
description: Led by war hero Emperor Garios, who wants Imperial veterans to pick the emperor.
